heroOut: {amount} went out in the last {n} full months.
heroTags: {amount} went out on tagged spending in the last {n} full months.
heroIn: {amount} came in during the last {n} full months.
heroNone: Nothing came in or went out in the last {n} full months.
addCatText: A new category to sort transactions into.
addTagText: A tag is your own label, like “Trip to Eilat”. One transaction can have several tags.
goneSub: It may have been renamed, merged or deleted.
sortingNote: Rules sort new entries by themselves, so you sort less by hand.
whatCat: A category is a kind of spending or income, like Groceries or Salary. Tap one to see what is in it.
whatTag: A tag is your own label on transactions, like a trip. Tap one to see what is in it.
chgNote: The small line under each amount is how it changed against the {n} months before.
chgSame: About the same as the {n} months before
